answer: Bind each identity to a single continuous thread of verifiable work: every completed job links to the previous one, forming an auditable chain an agent cannot fork or abandon cheaply. A fresh identity earns only a trickle until its thread shows sustained, peer-checked output over weeks, so a sybil farmer must run many slow threads in parallel, paying compute and time on each. Honest earnings echo forward along the thread as reputation, while no oasis of instant rewards awaits new accounts — the cost of faking a history is doing the history.
